mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_invite (project_id, inviter_user_id, token_hash, status, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{inviterUserId}, #{tokenHash}, 'active', #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.project_id, i.inviter_user_id, i.token_hash, i.status, i.expires_at, i.revoked_at, i.created_at, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, u.nick_name AS inviter_nick_name FROM project_invite i INNER JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = i.inviter_user_id WHERE i.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
SELECT id, project_id, inviter_user_id, token_hash, status, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at FROM project_invite WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
